section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a single study examining the factorial validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) across 2,393 participants (1,074 men and 1,319 women). The researchers tested multiple confirmatory factor models and found that a two-dimensional model with four items removed provided the best fit. Multiple-group analysis confirmed that the model structure was invariant across sex. General Body Appreciation scores were significantly negatively correlated with BMI among women (r = −.32) but not significantly correlated with BMI among men (r = −.02).
